raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Delivery Manager – Payments Transformation | BFSI (Payments and Trade Domain)
Services:Functional Project Manager with 18 years of dedicated experience within Banking and Financial Services (BFSI), specializing in Payments Transformation, ISO 20022 migration, Cross-Border Payments, and SWIFT modernization. Proven ability to lead strategic programs end-to-end, managing scope, budget, timeline, and regulatory compliance for global banking clients
Payments Transformation Delivery: Led end-to-end project lifecycle for ISO 20022 CBPR+ and regional FMI migration programs across EMEA, APAC, NAM, and LATAM. Managed planning, execution, governance, testing, and regulatory implementation on GPP SP platform covering 15+ partner applications.
Stakeholder & Change Management: Primary interface between business, compliance, product, and technology teams. Built strong relationships with senior stakeholders to drive consensus, manage change, and secure Go/No-Go decisions. Conducted requirement walkthroughs and executive deep-dive sessions
Project & Program Governance: Owned project planning, prioritization, resource negotiation, and milestone tracking. Systematically monitored risks/issues and implemented mitigation strategies to ensure 100% on-time delivery within SWIFT regulatory timelines.
Executive Reporting & Compliance: Prepared impact analysis, risk assessments, and
executive dashboards for Go/No-Go decisions and Post-Implementation Reviews. Ensured all deliverables complied with SWIFT standards, CBPR+ mandates, and payment regulations.
Cross-Functional Leadership: Managed and mentored cross-functional teams of 8-10
specialists. Led knowledge-sharing sessions and training to build payments domain capability across delivery units.
Core Payments Expertise: Extensive knowledge of *ISO 20022 messaging (pain.001,
pacs.008/009/002/004, camt.054/056/029), CBPR+ (cross-border payments), Clearing & Settlement systems including real-time payment flows, and SWIFT MT103/MT202/202COV • Payment Modernization: Deep experience with Payment Processing products *GPP SP and
Classic*. Translated business and regulatory requirements into functional solutions for MT→MX migration and payment modernization initiatives.
Business Analysis & Requirements: Partnered with BAs and stakeholders to define
business/technical requirements, acceptance criteria, and traceability for transformation deliverables.
